title: Raees Khan v. State of U.P. and Another
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.; Vikram D. Chauhan, J.
disposition: Writ declined; petitioner relegated to Section 127 appeal
headnote: A writ against a final assessment order passed under the Electricity Act, 2003 and the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is not examined where an appeal lies under Section 127. The petitioner is relegated to that statutory remedy.
facts: Raees Khan filed Writ-C No. 3551 of 2023 in the Allahabad High Court against the State of U.P. and another, challenging the final assessment order dated 14 October 2022 passed by respondent no. 2 under the Electricity Act, 2003 and the Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The order states no assessed amount, connection particulars, or ground of challenge beyond that final assessment.

holding_units.holding: The remedy against a final assessment order under the Electricity Act, 2003 and the Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is an appeal under Section 127. The High Court declines to examine the writ challenge and relegates the petitioner to that appeal.

principle_tags.application: The petitioner challenged the final assessment dated 14.10.2022. The Court treated Section 127 as the remedy and relegated him to that appeal without examining the assessment.
Because an appeal under Section 127 was available against the final assessment, the Court declined to examine the writ challenge.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the final assessment dated 14.10.2022
not_decided.note: Left entirely to the Section 127 appeal; the writ court declined to examine the challenge.
